description: Contract schema defining the required shape of a future Runtime Appendix schema carry field record. This schema defines field names, types, allowed values, and required constraints. It is a reference contract only — no Runtime Appendix record has been created, no schema output exists, and no carry has occurred.
nonAuthorizationStatement: This schema does not authorize schema output, JSON-LD generation, Astro attachment, runtime code creation, or production deployment. Mode 2 is not ready.

schema_bundle_id.description: Unique run ID of the approved schema output bundle. Must match the runId in the output bundle manifest and RUN_LEDGER.json.

schema_export_id.description: Unique export ID for this carry operation. Generated at bundle approval time. Must be unique across all carry operations.

schema_owner.description: The lane that owns and authored the schema. Must always be SEO_SCHEMA_OPERATOR. May not be set by runtime, CMS, or Astro lanes.

schema_source_lane.description: The lane from which the schema output was exported. Must always be SEO_SCHEMA_EXPORT.

target_route.description: The URL route for which the schema output was produced. Must match the Astro route exactly.

page_family.description: Page family category for the target route. Must match the page_family in the output bundle manifest.

schema_profile_expected.description: Schema profile expected at run intake. Must match the approved profile before drafting began.

schema_profile_actual.description: Schema profile actually used in the output bundle. Must exactly match schema_profile_expected. Mismatch triggers HOLD_SCHEMA_PROFILE_MISMATCH.

schema_validation_gate_status.description: Result of the 9-step final schema validation protocol. Must be PASS before Gate 8.

schema_evidence_map_status.description: Status of the evidence map for the target route. Must be PASS — all schema fields must trace to Phase 0 or confirmed page evidence.

schema_truth_fingerprint_status.description: Whether the output bundle truth fingerprint matches the locked Phase 0 homepage fingerprint (80edd829806cae271242c6a8e853edabdb8b2f16ca5a8fa1a3fc69ff5b78d53d). Must be PASS.

schema_attach_eligible.description: Whether the schema output bundle is eligible for Astro attachment. All 8 carry gates must pass and no hold codes may be active.

schema_attach_status.description: Whether schema has been attached to the Astro route. Starts as NOT_ATTACHED. Set to ATTACHED only after Gate 8 completes with human approval.

schema_hold_reasons.description: List of active hold codes blocking schema carry. Must be empty ([]) before Gate 8. All 15 hold codes from ASTRO_SCHEMA_CARRY_HOLD_REASON_REFERENCE_V1_0.md are active by default.

controller_decision_status.description: Final recommendation from controller review. Must be APPROVED with unresolvedBlockers: 0 before Gates 2 and Gate 6 Check 9.
controller_decision_status.additionalConstraint: APPROVED requires unresolvedBlockers equal to 0 in the controller review packet

human_approval_status.description: Whether explicit human approval for schema carry has been granted. Must be APPROVED with a valid humanApprovalRef. Cannot be self-granted by Claude or automated tooling.
human_approval_status.additionalConstraint: APPROVED requires a non-empty humanApprovalRef string

astro_route_manifest_status.description: Whether a confirmed Astro route manifest is available for the target route. Cannot be self-resolved — requires real Astro route evidence.

runtime_appendix_status.description: Overall status of the Runtime Appendix for this carry operation. PASS when all 18 fields meet requirements and no hold codes are active.
